value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, Saturdays 9:00 to 10:45, Sept 12 to Dec 18 - their site says; I could not pin down the price. Gellert's Tiny Dancers (2-3 yrs) is Sat 8:30, $117 for 12, and parent & tot skating is $4 adult, $2.50 child, but I could not pin down the day. I'll keep watching and text you if anything changes.
